这里说的威瑟斯彭是指……

sentences.en: Now, and it also dovetails into your book club thing because, listener, she reads, I think, correct me if I'm wrong, a book a day.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也和你的读书俱乐部有关，因为听众们，她读的书——如果我没记错的话——差不多是一天一本。

sentences.en: Do you really read a book a day?
sentences.zh: 你真的能一天读一本书吗？
我的眼睛有时候都看对眼了。

sentences.en: That's why I wear glasses a lot.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我经常戴眼镜。

sentences.en: Does that mean that you don't...
You'd rather read a book than a script?
sentences.zh: 你宁愿读一本书，也不愿读剧本吗？

sentences.en: I read scripts, but there aren't as many scripts because I, like, I'm very discerning about which books we develop.
sentences.zh: 我也会读剧本，但剧本没有那么多，因为我对我们开发哪本书非常挑剔。

sentences.en: The book club came out of...
sentences.zh: 读书俱乐部的诞生源于……

sentences.en: The first two books I optioned for my production company were Gone Girl and Wild.
sentences.zh: 我为我的制作公司买下版权的前两本书是《消失的爱人》和《涉足荒野》。

sentences.en: They both hit number one at the same time.
sentences.zh: 它们同时登上了排行榜第一名。

sentences.en: And somebody said to me, well, you're putting all this stuff on your Instagram.
sentences.zh: 然后有人对我说，你看，你把所有这些内容都发在Instagram上了。

sentences.en: Why don't you just make a separate Instagram about the books you read?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不单独做一个关于你读的书的Instagram账号呢？

sentences.en: And it just started doing really well.
sentences.zh: 然后它就开始做得非常成功。

sentences.en: And it actually has been this incredible opportunity to have first-time authors get their book noticed and seen.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这也成了一个不可思议的机会，让初次出道的作家们的书能够被关注、被看到。

sentences.en: And now are these publishers giving you early looks at things and hoping that you'll like it and that...
sentences.zh: 现在，这些出版商会提前把书拿给你看，希望你会喜欢，并且……

sentences.en: So I'm reading right now for February.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在正在看二月份的书。

sentences.en: Now, do you have people that you trust?
sentences.zh: 那么，你有信任的人帮你吗？

sentences.en: You've got to have people that help you with some of the reading.
sentences.zh: 你肯定得有帮手帮你读一部分书吧。

sentences.en: It's like me and one other person are reading.
My CEO of my company are doing it together.
sentences.zh: 我和我公司的首席执行官一起做这件事。

sentences.en: And so you're wading through all of it yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以这些你都是自己亲自过目啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, but you can get through...
Well, the first filter is it's written by a woman and it has a woman at the center of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，第一个筛选标准是作者必须是女性，且故事以女性为中心。

sentences.en: And I have a no women locked in a basement rule.
sentences.zh: 我有一个“绝不让女人被锁在地下室”的原则。

sentences.en: That actually reminds me of a story.
sentences.zh: 这其实让我想起了一个故事。

sentences.en: I was like, I'm doing Big Little Lies.
This executive in LA called me in at one of the major studios and he was like, hey, hey, I juSt...
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶一家大制片厂的高管把我叫去，他对我说，嘿，嘿，我刚……

sentences.en: We would love to have something like Big Little Lies at our studio.
sentences.zh: 我们很希望能在我们制片厂拍一部像《大小谎言》这样的作品。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, thank you so much.
He was like, it was so good.
I just have one little comment.
sentences.zh: 我只有一个小小的意见。
我简直不敢相信接下来要发生什么。
我简直不敢相信接下来要发生什么。

sentences.en: The guy's parts just, they're just not as good.
sentences.zh: 那个男主角的戏份就是，就是没那么好。

sentences.en: Not the name, but that was somebody at a buyer or...
sentences.zh: 不是问名字，那是买方的人还是……
他管理过一家大制片厂。
他昨天刚给我发了封邮件。

sentences.en: He's like, out of the business now, starting an app.
sentences.zh: 他说，现在已经不在这一行了，正在开发一个应用程序。

sentences.en: And he's like, hey, I'm starting an app.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，我在搞一个应用程序。

sentences.en: Do you have any guy-centric ideas for my app?
sentences.zh: 你有什么针对男性的点子可以给我的应用吗？

sentences.en: He had all guys starting the app, too.
sentences.zh: 他找来创业的也全都是男的。

sentences.en: I'm fascinated in the reading of it all.
sentences.zh: 我对阅读这件事本身非常着迷。

sentences.en: So are you a speed reader or are you just great?
sentences.zh: 所以你是速读手，还是单纯天生厉害？

sentences.en: Yeah, I can read really faSt.
sentences.zh: 对，我确实能读得非常快。

sentences.en: And that is just something that came naturally to you?
Or did you work on that when you were a kid?
I actually didn't know that was, like, something that everybody didn't have until I met my husband.
sentences.zh: 其实我直到遇到我丈夫之前，都不知道这不是每个人都具备的能力。

sentences.en: And we were probably going on a date or something one weekend.
sentences.zh: 我们大概是在哪个周末去约会或者干嘛的时候。

sentences.en: He was like, hey, can we go out of town?
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，我们能去外地吗？

sentences.en: I was like, yeah, I just have to read scripts.
sentences.zh: 我说，行啊，我只是得读剧本。

sentences.en: He's like, you're going to be reading a...
I was like, yeah, I just have three scripts to read.
sentences.zh: 我说，对，我只有三个剧本要读。

sentences.en: And he's like, that's going to take all weekend.
sentences.zh: 他说，那得花一整个周末吧。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, no, no, no.
I was like, it takes me about 45 minutes to read a script.
sentences.zh: 我说，我读一个剧本大概只需要45分钟。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I'm just going to...
sentences.zh: 然后呢，你知道的，我就会去……

sentences.en: I think my grandma was a first grade teacher.
sentences.zh: 我想我奶奶曾是一名一年级老师。

sentences.en: And she taught me how to read when I was four or five.
sentences.zh: 在我四五岁的时候，是她教我读书的。

sentences.en: And I think she taught me how to speed read.
sentences.zh: 我想是她教我学会了速读。

sentences.en: But I can't ask her because she's not here anymore.
sentences.zh: 但我没法问她了，因为她已经不在了。

sentences.en: But I do read really faSt.
sentences.zh: 不过我确实读得非常快。

sentences.en: It took Jason three days to read the definition of reading in the dictionary.
sentences.zh: 杰森花了三天时间才读完字典里“阅读”这个词的释义。

sentences.en: I couldn't figure out the left to right.
sentences.zh: 我当时搞不懂什么叫从左到右。

sentences.en: I had the top to bottom thing.
sentences.zh: 我只有从上到下的概念。

sentences.en: So do you know if you have a specific technique?
sentences.zh: 那你知不知道自己有没有什么特殊技巧？

sentences.en: Like some people say, like, they group three words at a time.
sentences.zh: 比如有些人说，他们一次看三个词。

sentences.en: But you know what is so fascinating?
sentences.zh: 但你知道最神奇的是什么吗？

sentences.en: Have you ever taken time on set to see how your fellow actor memorizes lines?
sentences.zh: 你有没有在片场花时间观察过你的同行演员是怎么背台词的？
因为这是一个非常孤立的……

sentences.en: So we all probably memorize our lines in different ways.
sentences.zh: 所以我们大概都用不同的方式背台词。

sentences.en: And so if you start to ask people what their tricks are, it has a lot to do with how you read.
sentences.zh: 如果你去问别人的诀窍是什么，这其实和你的阅读方式有很大关系。

sentences.en: Whenever you memorize lines, do you remember, like if you forget a word, but you remember the letter it starts with?
sentences.zh: 每当你在背台词时，如果你忘了一个词，但你还记得它是以哪个字母开头的？

sentences.en: It happens to me a lot.
You can see the whole page?
I can see the whole page.
All I have to do is see it basically once.
sentences.zh: 我基本上只要看一眼就行了。

sentences.en: Jason's the fastest I've ever worked with in terms of memorizing.
sentences.zh: 杰森是我合作过背台词速度最快的人。

sentences.en: He and I are both pretty quick at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我和他两个人的速度都挺快的。

sentences.en: I remember one time Jason and I were going to do a scene on Arrested when we were doing that Netflix season.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次，杰森和我打算在拍网飞那一季的《发展受阻》时拍一场戏。

sentences.en: And it was like eight pages.
And right as we were walking to set,
sentences.zh: 就在我们走向片场的时候，
米奇·霍罗威茨走过来说，

sentences.en: Hey, guys, we just rewrote it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们，我们刚刚重写了。

sentences.en: And it was one of the first scenes.
sentences.zh: 那是第一场戏中的一场。
我们俩当时一边走一边说，

sentences.en: And Jason and I would go, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 然后杰森和我就说，啦，啦，啦。

sentences.en: And then you're going to say, blah, blah, blah.
Also, Mitch Horowitz writes such good dialogue.
sentences.zh: 而且，米奇·霍洛维茨写的台词太棒了。

sentences.en: If it's well-written, it does go into your brain pretty easily.
sentences.zh: 如果写得好，确实很容易进脑子里。

sentences.en: So, Reese, when you memorize, though, are you going top to bottom on the page and you're just memorizing it like that?
sentences.zh: 那么，瑞茜，你背台词的时候，是从头到尾顺着页面这样死记硬背吗？

sentences.en: Or are you memorizing it in groups or thoughts?
sentences.zh: 还是按段落或意群来背？

sentences.en: Do you memorize it as fast as you read?
sentences.zh: 你背台词的速度有看书那么快吗？

sentences.en: I have to read it the night before, then during hair and makeup, then I have to say it alone in a quiet space, and then I have to hold the sides,
sentences.zh: 我得在前一晚先看一遍，然后在弄发型和化妆时看一遍，接着我得在一个安静的地方独自念出来，然后我得拿着台词页，

sentences.en: even though the sides have nothing to do.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些台词页根本没多大关系。

sentences.en: Sides are our little lines that we carry on set.
sentences.zh: 台词页就是我们带在片场的小纸条。

sentences.en: And then for the rehearsal, I have to hold them in my hand, and then during the blocking, wherever I stand is where I say the line.
sentences.zh: 然后排练时，我得把它拿在手里，接着在走位时，我站在哪里就在哪里说台词。

sentences.en: And if you change my blocking,
Yeah, I can't really remember my lines until the scene is blocked.
sentences.zh: 对，在场景走位定下来之前，我真的记不住台词。

sentences.en: Wait, I want to hear your process, Jason, because this kind of stuff is really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 等等，我想听听你的流程，杰森，因为这种事真的很迷人。

sentences.en: Is where you stand, where you sit, when you get up, all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 就是你站在哪，坐在哪，什么时候站起来，诸如此类的事情。

sentences.en: This is for Sean's aunt in Wisconsin, I believe it is.
sentences.zh: 我想这是为了肖恩在威斯康星州的姑妈准备的吧。

sentences.en: You see how excited Sean got?
sentences.zh: 你看到肖恩有多兴奋了吗？

sentences.en: He very kindly explained what sides are.
sentences.zh: 他非常友善地解释了什么是台词页。

sentences.en: And Sean was so excited because he loves explaining things.
sentences.zh: 肖恩兴奋得不得了，因为他喜欢解释事情。

sentences.en: What's her name, by the way?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下她叫什么名字？

sentences.en: So it's the Tracy ticker, bottom of the screen for the explanation.
sentences.zh: 所以屏幕下方会有个“特雷西小贴士”来做解释。

sentences.en: So what I do is I think a lot about how I'm going to do it, which is actually not really a good thing to do as an actor.
sentences.zh: 所以我通常会琢磨很多我该怎么演，作为演员来说这其实并不是什么好事。

sentences.en: And that's why I don't really get them perfectly memorized before I do it because I don't want to nail in how I'm going to do it
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我在开拍前不会把台词背得死死的，因为我不想把表演方式框死，

sentences.en: because I got to leave room for how you're going to be doing your lines, you know, so I can be flexible with performance.
sentences.zh: 因为我得给你们的台词留出空间，你知道的，这样我在表演时才能灵活应变。

sentences.en: So actually I learn my lines specifically once we do our rehearsal and then they're lighting the shot and the stand-ins are in there.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，我是等到我们排练完，然后他们开始打光、替身演员上场时，我才专门去学台词。

sentences.en: Have you ever had this moment on set where you're looking at somebody and they're doing such incredible work, you forget the lines?
sentences.zh: 你在片场有没有过这种时刻：看着某个人，他们演得太棒了，以至于你把台词都忘了？
对，你开始看着他们入迷了。

sentences.en: I do that a lot when I'm directing.
You get out of your body and you start looking at them and going like, either, holy shit, they're so bad in this scene or,
sentences.zh: 你会出戏，开始看着他们心想，要么是“操，他们在这一场里演得太烂了”，要么是

sentences.en: oh, my God, I can't believe I get to act with this human.
sentences.zh: “天哪，我简直不敢相信自己能和这个人演戏。”

sentences.en: When I'm directing something that I'm in, I've got to be doing that.
sentences.zh: 当我自导自演时，我必须得这么做。

sentences.en: Like I've got to be watching their performance at the same time.
sentences.zh: 就像我得同时观察他们的表演一样。

sentences.en: So, yeah, sometimes it is – and you're thinking about, oh, my God, how am I going to edit around this performance?
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，有时候——你会想，天哪，我该怎么剪辑掉这段表演周围的戏份？

sentences.en: It's got to be so hard.
But it's fun because it's a great – it's a perfect seat to have.
sentences.zh: 但这也很有趣，因为这是一个绝佳的位置——一个完美的位置。

sentences.en: Like you're right there and you can actually – if they're open to it, you can give them adjustments and notes while you're inside the scene.
sentences.zh: 就像你就在旁边，如果他们乐意接受，你甚至可以在身处场景之中的同时给他们调整和意见。

sentences.en: You don't necessarily have to wait until the end and try to remember your notes and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你没必要非得等到最后再去努力回忆你的意见之类的。

sentences.en: I can't memorize lines without making a choice.
sentences.zh: 我不做抉择就记不住台词。

sentences.en: I know a lot of actors, like you just said, Jason, they memorize the words but they wait until rehearsal to kind of figure out how it goes.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多演员，就像你刚才说的，杰森，他们死记硬背词句，但要等到排练时才去琢磨怎么演。

sentences.en: Some will even write it down.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至会把它们写下来。

sentences.en: They'll write their lines out and they'll remember every single word, like real staccato.
sentences.zh: 他们会把台词写出来，然后记住每一个字，一顿一顿的。

sentences.en: I worked with this actor once and he couldn't – if you ad-libbed it all, and it was a comedy, so you got to just be loose, you know,
sentences.zh: 我以前合作过一个演员，他完全不行——如果你即兴发挥哪怕一点，而那是一部喜剧，所以你必须放得开，你知道的，

sentences.en: because that stuff gets really stuck and not funny.
sentences.zh: 因为太死板的话就一点都不好笑了。

sentences.en: It gets not funny after take three.
sentences.zh: 拍到第三条时就完全不好笑了。

sentences.en: And if I didn't say the last written line, he literally only knew my last word.
sentences.zh: 如果我没说最后那句写好的台词，他 literalmente 只能听懂我的最后一个词。

sentences.en: So if I didn't say the word, he would remember his line.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我没说那个词，他就记不起自己的台词。

sentences.en: And I thought, he's not listening to me at all.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，他根本没在听我说话。

sentences.en: I've worked with people like that who are like, oh, sorry, I didn't hear the cue.
sentences.zh: 我合作过那种人，他们会说：“哦，抱歉，我没听到暗号。”

sentences.en: And you're like, well, how did you not know that I was saying the same thing?
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，好吧，你怎么会没注意到我说的就是那句话？

sentences.en: I usually just wait for a huge gaping pause, and that's when I know I come in.
sentences.zh: 我通常只是等着一个巨大的空白停顿，然后我就知道该我上了。

sentences.en: I spend half my time so excited about doing something that's going to crack the other person up, so I'm just giddy.
sentences.zh: 我有一半的时间都在兴奋地想着要做点什么来把对方逗乐，所以我整个人飘飘然的。

sentences.en: I'm like bursting to fuck around at all times, even in life, that I'm just like giddy.
sentences.zh: 我随时随地都兴奋得想搞怪，甚至在生活中也是如此，我就像个疯丫头一样。

sentences.en: That's so fun to be around people who are like so excited to ad-lib.
sentences.zh: 身边有一群特别热衷于即兴发挥的人，真的太有趣了。

sentences.en: You guys seem to be having that kind of vibe on Morning Show.
sentences.zh: 你们在《早间新闻》剧组似乎就有这种氛围。

sentences.en: We don't ad-lib that much on Morning Show, but we have such great dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我们在《早间新闻》里其实不怎么即兴发挥，但我们的台词太棒了。

sentences.en: By the way, I love the show, and you're fantastic on it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我超喜欢这部剧，你在里面演得棒极了。

sentences.en: It's great to work with Jen every day, and all those incredible people.
sentences.zh: 每天能和珍以及所有那些了不起的人一起工作，感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: And even like Martin Short came on our show, and I was freaking out.
sentences.zh: 甚至连马丁·肖特也来过我们节目，当时我都惊呆了。

sentences.en: I think he got nominated, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 我想他被提名了吧，对吗？

sentences.en: When do you guys go back?
sentences.zh: 你们什么时候回去开工？

sentences.en: We're going to go back right now.
I've been talking to some friends who are on sets and wearing masks, and then I'm like, what's it like to try and stay in the scene,
sentences.zh: 我跟一些在片场戴着口罩的朋友聊过，然后我就想，一边努力入戏，

sentences.en: but then also stay safe and keep everybody safe?
sentences.zh: 一边又要保持安全、确保每个人都安全，那会是什么感觉？

sentences.en: So I'm just kind of trying to mentally prepare for that, but I'm excited to work again because I'm going nuts over here.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在正在做心理建设，不过我很高兴能再次工作，因为我快被憋疯了。
我们竟然该死的开了一个播客。

sentences.en: You guys are having so much fun to listen to you.
sentences.zh: 听你们聊天实在太有趣了。
我给明蒂·卡灵打了个电话。

sentences.en: I was like, should we be doing what those guys are doing?
sentences.zh: 我说：“我们是不是也该像那群人一样搞一个？”

sentences.en: Well, your list of accomplishments is endless.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，你的成就简直数不胜数。

sentences.en: Speaking of like, I don't know what to do with myself, because I'm similar, but you're much more prolific than I am.
sentences.zh: 说到“我不知道该拿自己怎么办”，因为我也差不多，但你比我高产太多了。

sentences.en: Your acting career, your producing career, your clothing company, your book club, you're like in seven television shows right now all at once.
sentences.zh: 你的演员生涯、制片人生涯、服装公司、读书俱乐部，你现在同时参演了大约七部电视剧。

sentences.en: Oh, and oh, you're a mom.
I mean, these guys know my story, but what in the hell happened to you as a child
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大家或许知道我的故事，但你小时候到底经历了什么鬼，

sentences.en: that gave you this like boundless ambition?
sentences.zh: 才让你有了这种永无止境的野心？

sentences.en: Well, I was always like a really overachieving kid, but I wanted, you know, I think every actor has to kind of dig down and figure out who are you trying to make happy?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从小就是一个好胜心极强的小孩，但我想要……你知道的，我觉得每个演员都得深入挖掘一下，弄清楚你究竟想让谁开心？

sentences.en: So once you figure that out, like I figured that out through seven years of therapy.
sentences.zh: 所以一旦你弄明白了这一点——我是通过七年的心理治疗才弄明白的。

sentences.en: Well, I think I graduated from therapy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我的心理治疗算毕业了。

sentences.en: So I just like didn't go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是……就哪儿也没去了。

sentences.en: But then when she figured it out.
sentences.zh: 但后来当她发现的时候。

sentences.en: I'm still trying to get my out of boys.
sentences.zh: 我还在努力摆脱对男孩的讨好。

sentences.en: So it's usually like, whose approval are you trying to get?
sentences.zh: 所以通常是这样的，你在试图获得谁的认可？

sentences.en: And once you kind of solve that puzzle, then it's like, okay, why am I still doing this?
sentences.zh: 一旦你解开这个谜题，就会想，好吧，我为什么还要这么做？

sentences.en: That's when my whole career shifted to more purpose-driven.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，我的整个职业生涯转向了更有使命感的事业。

sentences.en: I want more women behind the camera.
sentences.zh: 我希望镜头后面有更多女性。

sentences.en: I want to see more stories written from a woman's perspective by a woman.
sentences.zh: 我希望看到更多由女性视角、由女性创作的故事。

sentences.en: I want to have women make more money.
And it just gave me fuel, you know?
sentences.zh: 这给了我动力，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Is that what inspired you to, in the lead, in the way of fight for women's equality and equal pay for genders?
sentences.zh: 这就是激励你带头去争取女性平等以及性别同工同酬的原因吗？

sentences.en: And do you think your efforts have paid off?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你们的努力有回报吗？
我们现在进展到哪一步了？

sentences.en: I mean, I see so much shifting, so much more consciousness.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我看到了太多的转变，意识提高了很多。

sentences.en: People are actually having these conversations and discussions.
sentences.zh: 人们真的在进行这些对话和讨论。

sentences.en: I mean, y'all know how prolific it was.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你们知道以前有多严重。

sentences.en: There were no people of color at agencies and no people of color as executives at studios.
sentences.zh: 经纪公司里没有有色人种，制片厂的高管里也没有有色人种。

sentences.en: And now I'm seeing so much more of an effort to actually diversify storytelling by changing the storytellers, but also the executives that make the decisions
sentences.zh: 而现在，我看到更多的努力在真正实现讲故事的多元化，不仅是通过改变讲故事的人，还有那些做决策的高管

sentences.en: are just becoming more diverse, which is going to really create a better diversity of programming.
sentences.zh: 也变得越来越多元化，这必将真正带来更丰富的节目多元化。

sentences.en: And the emergence of streaming has helped everyone because it opens it up.
sentences.zh: 而流媒体的出现对所有人都有帮助，因为它打开了局面。

sentences.en: when I was first dating Amy, my ex-wife, and then when we were married and people would talk, you know, there was that whole thing.
sentences.zh: 当我刚开始和我的前妻艾米约会时，然后当我们结婚后，人们就会议论，你知道，当时有那种说法。

sentences.en: It used to be like, you know, like, well, there was always that argument, like, women aren't as funny.
sentences.zh: 过去那种说法就像是，你知道的，总是有那种争论，比如，女性没有那么搞笑。

sentences.en: And I was like, not as funny.
sentences.zh: 而我会说，没有那么搞笑？

sentences.en: The funniest people I know are women.
sentences.zh: 我认识的最搞笑的人就是女性。

sentences.en: And Tina and Maya and Rachel Dratch.
sentences.zh: 还有蒂娜、玛雅和雷切尔·德拉奇。

sentences.en: I'm like, are you for fucking real?
sentences.zh: 我都想说，你们他妈的是认真的吗？
她们就是最搞笑的人，没别的。

sentences.en: And the fact that there was even a debate was so absurd.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有人为此争论，这简直荒谬透顶。

sentences.en: Although it should be noted, one time I did an interview and they said, what's it like being married to the funniest person in America?
sentences.zh: 不过值得一提的是，有一次我接受采访，他们问我，和一个全美最搞笑的人结婚是什么感觉？

sentences.en: And I said, you'd have to ask my wife.
You don't think you guys got divorced three days later?
sentences.zh: 你们难道不觉得你们三天后就离婚了吗？

sentences.en: Are you excited about Kamala Harris?
sentences.zh: 你对卡玛拉·哈里斯感到兴奋吗？

sentences.en: Y'all, your interview with her was so well-timed.
sentences.zh: 各位，你们对她的采访时机太好了。

sentences.en: We were chasing it for a little while.
And then the fact that she said, you know, she picked the date and we were like, she must know that she's picking a date the week that he's going to make his pick.
sentences.zh: 然后事实上她说，你知道，她挑了一个日期，当时我们就想，她肯定知道她挑的这个日期，正好是他要宣布人选的那周。

sentences.en: She called us like the week before and was like, we got to go now.
sentences.zh: 她在前一周左右给我们打电话说，我们现在必须上了。

sentences.en: And at that point, we were like, uh-oh, this is happening, y'all.
sentences.zh: 当时我们就想，哦哦，这事要成了，各位。

sentences.en: You all raced to the microphones.
You know, that she just represents so much to women out there, little girls, little girls, black and brown girls all over this country now know that anything is possible.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她对女性、小女孩，以及全美各地所有黑人和棕色人种小女孩来说代表了太多，现在她们知道一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: And it's so important, you know?
We'd be so lucky to have her as vice president and then hopefully president.
sentences.zh: 能让她担任副总统，然后有望担任总统，我们会非常幸运。

sentences.en: Anybody who dedicates their life to public service like that is just really remarkable.
sentences.zh: 任何像这样把一生奉献给公共服务的人都非常了不起。

sentences.en: And I'm also fascinated about her husband, Doug.
sentences.zh: 而且我对她的丈夫道格也很着迷。

sentences.en: I want to learn about Doug.
I want to follow Doug for the next 12 years.
sentences.zh: 我想在接下来的12年里关注道格。

sentences.en: I want to see what's going on with him.
sentences.zh: 我想看看他都在忙些什么。

sentences.en: We talked to him for a minute at the start.
sentences.zh: 我们在开始时跟他聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: He was setting up her computer.
He was doing all the tech stuff, right?
sentences.zh: 他在搞那些科技设备，对吧？
而且他们有很棒的孩子。

sentences.en: And we said, what's it like?
sentences.zh: 然后我们问，那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: He said, Jason said, the vetting process just must be pretty intense.
sentences.zh: 他说，杰森说，背景审查的过程肯定相当严格。

sentences.en: He goes, you have no idea.
sentences.zh: 他说，你们根本无法想象。

sentences.en: He looked hot straight into the camera.
It was the only time he did it.
sentences.zh: 那是他唯一一次这样做。

sentences.en: Would y'all ever want to run for office?
sentences.zh: 你们俩想过竞选公职吗？

sentences.en: I know y'all asked that on the show, but I wonder.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们在节目里问过这个，但我很好奇。

sentences.en: I mean, these guys said that I could never be the prime minister of Canada, which I took great umbrage with.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这几位说我永远不可能成为加拿大的首相，我对此感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think with your dual citizenship, you've kind of screwed yourself out of both.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得凭你的双重国籍，你把两边都搞砸了。

sentences.en: Because you already act like you're president of so many companies.
sentences.zh: 因为你表现得就像那么多家公司的总裁一样。

sentences.en: You have that intelligence and charm and like ability and all of those things that are needed.
sentences.zh: 你具备那种所需的智慧、魅力、好人缘以及所有这些特质。

sentences.en: And people look up to you and they listen to you because you are an influencer.
sentences.zh: 人们崇拜你，倾听你，因为你是一个有影响力的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think you'd get a lot of the vote.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得你能赢得很多选票。

sentences.en: You'd be a senator like this.
sentences.zh: 你轻而易举就能当上参议员。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean our standards have become very low in this country.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说我们在这个国家的标准已经变得很低了。

sentences.en: Sonny Bono was one of our congressmen.
sentences.zh: 桑尼·博诺曾是我们的国会议员之一。

sentences.en: We don't have to say that the bar is low for Reese to do this.
sentences.zh: 我们没必要说瑞茜做这事的门槛很低。

sentences.en: No, I mean I'm just saying it's like, you know, come on.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我是说，你知道的，拜托。

sentences.en: If you ever get bored of killing it in this industry.
sentences.zh: 如果你有一天厌倦了这个行业的风生水起。
我热爱我们所做的事情。

sentences.en: I feel so lucky to do with this.
sentences.zh: 能做这个我感到非常幸运。

sentences.en: I feel like— So you would never want to do that?
sentences.zh: 我觉得——所以你永远不想那样做？

sentences.en: I mean I wouldn't say never because I don't know where I'm going to be when I'm, you know, 65.
sentences.zh: 我是说我不会把话说死，因为我不知道我65岁的时候会在哪里。

sentences.en: The thing that's seductive about the whole notion of running for politics for anybody, I'm sure, is you look at some of these problems and you just think the answer is so simple.
sentences.zh: 对于任何人来说，从政这个概念最诱人的地方，我敢肯定，就是当你看到其中一些问题时，你会觉得答案是如此简单。

sentences.en: Well, I think we need a better representation and balance too.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我们也需要更好的代表性和平衡。

sentences.en: I mean women are 50% of the population, but we're not 50% of the representation in government, which is bizarre,
sentences.zh: 我是说女性占人口的50%，但我们在政府中的代表比例却没有达到50%，这很怪异，

sentences.en: particularly when they're adjudicating over our bodies and the lack of representation of people of color who make up a large, almost majority of this country.
sentences.zh: 特别是当他们在对我们的身体指手画脚时，而且缺乏占这个国家绝大多数、几乎是多数的有色人种的代表。

sentences.en: What about balance, you know, just yin and yang, male-female balance.
sentences.zh: 那平衡呢，你知道的，就是阴阳平衡，男女平衡。

sentences.en: I love all the countries that have handled COVID well are all run by women.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢所有那些将新冠疫情处理得很好的国家都是由女性领导的。

sentences.en: So, like, you know, full stop.
That's all you need to say.
sentences.zh: 这就是你需要说的全部。

sentences.en: Well, I think women have a different relationship to power.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得女性对权力的理解有所不同。

sentences.en: But it's interesting how no one needs to be the number one.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，没有人需要当老大。

sentences.en: We sort of pass the baton almoSt.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎像是击鼓传花一样。

sentences.en: You know, it's always kind of deferring power or sharing responsibility.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这总是一种权力下放或责任分担。

sentences.en: So, it's almost this power balance and that there's no one person sort of dictating or mandating exactly what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以，这几乎是一种权力平衡，没有一个人在发号施令或强制规定具体该怎么做。

sentences.en: And it works really well for—
sentences.zh: 而且这效果真的很好，对于——

sentences.en: Someone's doing a case study at it at one of the big business schools.
sentences.zh: 有人正在其中一所知名商学院把这当作案例研究呢。

sentences.en: You know, so we've got to change the way— And what you're talking about is changing the way—
sentences.zh: 你知道的，所以我们必须改变方式——而你所说的是改变方式——

sentences.en: Changing our perspective on how we look at things and how—
sentences.zh: 改变我们看待事物以及如何——的视角

sentences.en: Reese, how are you managing your kids during this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 瑞茜，在这个疫情期间你是怎么管孩子的？

sentences.en: Are you, like, you—are you pulling your hair out trying to keep them from having playdates with a family that might not be as isolated as you guys?
sentences.zh: 你是不是，就像，你——你是不是急得焦头烂额，想方设法阻止他们去和一个可能不如你们隔离得那么严密的家庭约着玩？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm asking because I'm dealing with it myself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我这么问是因为我自己也在应付这事。

sentences.en: And I know you're a great mom.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道你是个好妈妈。
我很喜欢你那几个可爱的女儿。

sentences.en: But your decisions as a parent are probably better than mine, so I want to know what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 但你作为一个家长的决定可能比我明智，所以我很想知道你是怎么做的。

sentences.en: I don't know about that, but I think the hardest piece is I have a daughter in college, right?
sentences.zh: 这我可不敢说，但我觉得最难的部分是，我有一个上大学的女儿，对吧？

sentences.en: So, I have a daughter in college and I have a teenage son who's 16, going to be 17.
sentences.zh: 所以，我有一个上大学的女儿，还有一个16岁快要17岁的青春期儿子。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's easy to keep my seven-year-old at home, but I think a big piece of being a person that age is social development.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，让七岁的小女儿待在家很简单，但我觉得那个年纪的孩子很大一部分需要社交发展。

sentences.en: I mean, the depression that happened at the beginning of this pandemic between the two of them, not being able to see anybody and just, you know,
sentences.zh: 我是说，这场疫情刚开始时，他们俩之间出现的抑郁情绪，不能见任何人，然后，你知道，

sentences.en: trusting—my daughter is back at college, you know, but I trust her implicitly.
sentences.zh: 信任——我女儿已经回大学了，你知道，但我对她绝对信任。

sentences.en: She's not in classes, but she has small study groups here and there.
sentences.zh: 她不上大课，但零星有一些小型学习小组。

sentences.en: And that's just—it's terrifying to me, guys.
sentences.zh: 而这简直——这让我感到害怕，伙计们。

sentences.en: And I miss her like crazy.
But I just keep checking in with her like, you know, you got to do this.
sentences.zh: 但我就是不断跟她沟通，你知道的，你必须这么做。

sentences.en: I know I'm going to sound like a broken record, but don't do this.
sentences.zh: 我知道我听起来像个碎碎念的复读机，但别这么干。

sentences.en: The seven-year-old, that's because I've got an eight-year-old and a 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 至于七岁那个，那是因为我还有一个八岁和一个十三岁的。

sentences.en: And the eight-year-old, I would love to figure out how to get into some sort of like a—almost like look online for like clean playgroups, you know?
sentences.zh: 至于八岁这个，我很想知道怎么才能加入某种——几乎像是在网上找那种干净的玩伴小组，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like, I'm like shopping for friends for a situation where she can get that social interaction because—
sentences.zh: 就像我在为她物色朋友，好让她能有那种社交互动，因为——
哦，我们正在组建一个育儿微小群体。

sentences.en: We're doing a school pod with like six other families.
sentences.zh: 我们正和另外大约六个家庭一起搞一个学校微小群体。

sentences.en: And we're starting next week when we get back.

sentences.zh: 而且是的，每个人都很干净健康。
所有人都经过了背景审查。
我自己给每个人测体温。

sentences.en: I test everybody and I tempt them all myself.
sentences.zh: 我亲自测试每个人，并给他们所有人量体温。

sentences.en: And I keep them locked in my garage.
sentences.zh: 然后我把他们锁在我的车库里。

sentences.en: And then the kids, now they can go over and they can get their learning from school.
sentences.zh: 然后孩子们，现在他们可以过去，可以从学校获取知识。

sentences.en: And we hired this friend's sister who's an out-of-work teacher to come and be to help them.
sentences.zh: 我们雇了一个朋友的妹妹，她是个失业的老师，来这里帮忙。

sentences.en: And because the first part of the pandemic, the kids were, like you said, they were going crazy.
sentences.zh: 因为在疫情的第一阶段，孩子们，就像你说的，他们快疯了。

sentences.en: And they also didn't want—they had me or their mom.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也不想——他们只有我和他们妈妈。

sentences.en: Both of us were, like, over their shoulders.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都，就像，盯着他们。

sentences.en: Like, they didn't want to take direction of schoolwork from us.
sentences.zh: 就是，他们不想接受我们对他们功课的指导。

sentences.en: Oh, by the way, Will, like, also no one's talking about this, which is families that are divorced.
sentences.zh: 哦，顺便说一句，威尔，还有，没有人谈论这个，那就是离异家庭。

sentences.en: And if you don't have a good relationship with your ex-partner, it is—I mean, I know people who are losing their minds over fighting on top of fighting.
sentences.zh: 如果你和前任关系不好的话，那简直是——我的意思是，我认识的人为了吵架再加上吵架都快急疯了。
这真的，真的是压力山大。

sentences.en: And stressful on the kids so much.
sentences.zh: 对孩子们的压力也特别大。

sentences.en: There's a big—there are so many mental health implications here.
sentences.zh: 这里面有很大一部分——有很多心理健康方面的影响。

sentences.en: We're really lucky that we bubbled up together and we're good friends.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很幸运，能聚在一起形成一个防疫泡泡，而且我们都是好朋友。

sentences.en: We live on the same street and all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们住在同一条街上诸如此类的。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of people who that's not the case.
sentences.zh: 但也有很多人并非如此。

sentences.en: And it's going to be a while before we really start seeing what sort of effect this has had on families, like you said.
sentences.zh: 而且还要过一段时间，我们才能真正开始看到这种经历对家庭造成了什么样的影响，就像你说的。

sentences.en: I try to share a lot of resources on Instagram for parents, like Child Mind Institute in New York does some online services.
sentences.zh: 我尽量在Instagram上为家长们分享很多资源，比如纽约的Child Mind Institute就提供一些在线服务。

sentences.en: There's a lot of great sources.
And, you know, hopefully you can look to people who are sharing stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，希望你能去关注那些分享内容的人。

sentences.en: So, Reese, now, you did a Friends arc, did you not, where you were in front of an audience?
sentences.zh: 那么，瑞茜，你之前演过《老友记》里的客串戏份，对吧，就是在观众面前表演？

sentences.en: Would you ever do a sitcom in front of a live audience?
sentences.zh: 你会在现场观众面前演情景喜剧吗？

sentences.en: It scared the living crap out of me.

sentences.zh: 没有那种刺激的快感吗？
没有那种好玩的刺激吗？

sentences.en: You did Saturday Night Live right after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 你9-11之后马上就上了《周六夜现场》。

sentences.en: I'd done Saturday Night Live twice.
sentences.zh: 我上过两次《周六夜现场》。

sentences.en: I was the first person after 9-11.
sentences.zh: 我是9-11之后第一个去的人。

sentences.en: Lauren was like, we have to do this.
sentences.zh: 洛恩当时说，我们必须这么做。

sentences.en: No, you're going to do it.
Reese is going to do it.
Why are you in my bedroom?
Will was trying to imitate Lauren Michaels, the head of Saturday Night Live.
sentences.zh: 威尔刚才在模仿《周六夜现场》的负责人洛恩·麦克尔斯。

sentences.en: But can I tell y'all, Saturday Night Live is the scariest thing I've ever done.
sentences.zh: 但我得告诉你们，主创《周六夜现场》是我这辈子做过最吓人的事。

sentences.en: It's the scariest job I've ever done that I haven't been paid for.
sentences.zh: 这是我做过的最吓人而且还没拿报酬的工作。
那是埃米的第一期节目。
那是埃米的第一期节目。

sentences.en: Oh, I was so bad, Will.
sentences.zh: 哦，我当时表现太差了，威尔。

sentences.en: You know how some people just nail SNL?
sentences.zh: 你知道有些人上《周六夜现场》就是能完美驾驭吗？

sentences.en: There was a lot of pressure.
Like you said, there was a lot of pressure.
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，压力太大了。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was so much pressure in that moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那一刻压力太大了。

sentences.en: Somebody should talk about, like, I thought that 40-year special was cool, how people talked about what those feelings are like.
sentences.zh: 应该有人来聊聊，比如，我觉得那个四十周年特别节目很酷，大家都在讨论那种感受是怎样的。
难道你不觉得我很害怕吗？

sentences.en: So you would not do a sitcom because you think it would be too frightening every week, week after week?
sentences.zh: 所以你不会去拍情景喜剧，因为你觉得每周都要面对这种事太吓人了，一周接一周？

sentences.en: I think you would love it.

sentences.zh: 我觉得你会玩得很开心。

sentences.en: After you've already taken over the world, because is there anything left you want to tackle?
sentences.zh: 在你已经征服了世界之后，还有什么你想挑战的吗？

sentences.en: I would love to have a bookstore.
And then sell tiny, tiny, tiny, tiny little artisanal chocolates.
sentences.zh: 然后卖那种超级、超级、超级小的手工巧克力。

sentences.en: We'll be right back after these messages.
Reese, can I talk to you?

sentences.zh: 我们正在和玛莎·斯图尔特聊天。

sentences.en: Let me get the number for your therapist real quick, because I think we would have an emergency situation.
sentences.zh: 赶紧把你的心理医生电话给我，因为我觉得我们要进入紧急状态了。

sentences.en: So tiny chocolates at a bookstore.
sentences.zh: 所以在书店里卖超小块巧克力。

sentences.en: Do you think that having a bookstore would be the best way to attract a chocolate?
sentences.zh: 你觉得开一家书店是吸引巧克力的最佳方式吗？

sentences.en: Somebody who's in the market to buy chocolate, you're going to—
sentences.zh: 对于那些正打算买巧克力的人，你要——

sentences.en: You guys are going to like this one.
I am going to become a farmer, and I'm only going to plant peaches and call it Reese's
sentences.zh: 我要去当个农民，而且我只种桃子，还要把它叫做瑞丝的

sentences.en: Because you can't be sad on a peach farm.
sentences.zh: 因为你在桃子农场里是绝对不会难过的。

sentences.en: I love a peach salad in the summer.
sentences.zh: 我夏天特别喜欢吃桃子沙拉。

sentences.en: How good is a peach salad?
I mean, who doesn't like peaches?
sentences.zh: 我是说，谁会不喜欢桃子呢？

sentences.en: Maybe you could sell the peaches at the bookstore with the chocolate.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以在书店里和巧克力一起卖桃子。

sentences.en: But the chocolates will be at the counter as people are buying their books.
sentences.zh: 但巧克力会摆在柜台上，供大家买书时顺便挑选。

sentences.en: You can get the chocolates anywhere, okay?
sentences.zh: 你在哪儿都能买到巧克力，好吗？

sentences.en: I just like making tiny chocolates.
sentences.zh: 我就是喜欢做那种超小的巧克力。
你做起饭来也跟疯了一样吗？

sentences.en: I'm not a great cook, but I can cook.
sentences.zh: 我算不上顶级大厨，但我会做饭。

sentences.en: Okay, because here's my image of Reese Witherspoon.
sentences.zh: 好吧，因为这就是我对瑞丝·威瑟斯彭的印象。

sentences.en: You wake up, and you don't stop moving until you go to sleep at night.
sentences.zh: 你一醒来，就会一直动个不停，直到晚上睡觉。

sentences.en: I bet there's a bunch of little yellow birds in your bedroom, though, too, when you wake up, right?
sentences.zh: 我敢说你卧室里醒来时肯定也有一群小黄鸟，对吧？

sentences.en: The energy of a squirrel who drank coffee is me all day.
sentences.zh: 我整天都像一只喝了咖啡的松鼠一样充满活力。

sentences.en: And I'll bet you never got a B in school, right?
sentences.zh: 我敢说你上学时从来没拿过B，对吧？

sentences.en: I only got a straight F.

sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，谁需要那玩意儿？
我从来没学到那么高深。

sentences.en: I think I made it to Algebra 2.
And now my kid is in second grade.
sentences.zh: 现在我孩子上二年级了。

sentences.en: I can't do the math that he's doing.
sentences.zh: 他做的数学题我都不会了。

sentences.en: I went to a math, I went to a, they had like a math symposium for, when Archie was in fourth grade, to talk about how they were redoing the math.
sentences.zh: 我去参加过一个数学，我去过一个，他们为阿奇四年级的时候办了一个类似数学研讨会的活动，讨论他们是怎么改革数学教学的。

sentences.en: I was like, I got to go with a bunch of other parents.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，我得和其他家长一起去看看。

sentences.en: And I kept sticking my hand up.
Yeah, it's what they're changing to.
sentences.zh: 对，那是他们正在改成的教学方式。

sentences.en: Reese, lookit, fine lady, thank you for being here today.
sentences.zh: 瑞丝，听着，好女士，谢谢你今天能来。

sentences.en: I'm so happy for everything that you've accomplished in your life.
sentences.zh: 我为你一生中所取得的一切成就感到由衷的高兴。

sentences.en: You make us all feel lazy.
sentences.zh: 你让我们所有人都觉得自己好懒。

sentences.en: And I hope you're getting everything your heart desires because you deserve everything.
sentences.zh: 我希望你心想事成，因为你配得上所有这一切。

sentences.en: Sean also has the energy of a squirrel who just drank coffee.
sentences.zh: 肖恩也像一只刚喝完咖啡的松鼠一样充满活力。

sentences.en: But then ate two pints of ice cream and sat on the couch.
sentences.zh: 但紧接着又吃了两大品脱冰淇淋，然后瘫在沙发上。

sentences.en: So he took it all down.
sentences.zh: 所以他把那股劲全泄掉了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I need a sugar nap.
sentences.zh: 对，我需要吃点糖睡一觉。

sentences.en: That was, I think that was the fastest hour I have felt.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我感觉过最快的一个小时。

sentences.en: I'm just such a huge fan of all of you.
sentences.zh: 我真的是你们所有人的超级大粉丝。

sentences.en: I've gotten to work with most of you.
sentences.zh: 你们大多数我都合作过。

sentences.en: We just love each other from afar.
sentences.zh: 我们只是隔空相爱罢了。

sentences.en: Convince her to do a sitcom with you.
sentences.zh: 说服她跟你一起拍一部情景喜剧。

sentences.en: I will be all over that.
Reese, you have honored us with your presence.
sentences.zh: 瑞丝，你能光临真是让我们蓬荜生辉。

sentences.en: You're fantastic and interesting and cool and all of the above.
sentences.zh: 你既棒极了、有趣、又酷，总之集所有优点于一身。

sentences.en: And thank you for coming and joining us, idiots.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们大驾光临，陪着我们这群白痴。

sentences.en: That is such a special lady.
sentences.zh: 她真是一位特别的女士。

sentences.en: Doesn't she make you feel like, God, I've done nothing?
sentences.zh: 难道她没让你觉得，天哪，我什么都没做吗？

sentences.en: I don't think I've ever been that happy or energetic or ready to take on the day.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我从来没有像她那样快乐、充满活力、时刻准备迎接新的一天。

sentences.en: You've definitely never been that energetic.
sentences.zh: 你绝对从来没那么有活力过。

sentences.en: And your face has never been that happy, for sure.
sentences.zh: 而且你的脸肯定从来没露出过那种快乐的表情。

sentences.en: I mean, I felt that happy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我心里感到那么快乐。

sentences.en: I just haven't told my face yet.
sentences.zh: 我只是还没告诉我的脸而已。

sentences.en: You've never told your face that.
sentences.zh: 你可从来没跟你的脸说过这事。

sentences.en: But she is, like, it is, it's amazing how many different things she's doing at once at all times.
sentences.zh: 但她就是……她随时随地能同时做那么多不同的事情，这太惊人了。

sentences.en: And doing it at such a high level.
sentences.zh: 而且能达到这么高的水平。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's got the Midas touch.
sentences.zh: 对，她有着点石成金的本事。

sentences.en: And whether it's movies or, like, multiple television programs that are kind of seemingly running one into the next.
sentences.zh: 无论是电影还是多档电视节目，看起来一部接一部地在播。

sentences.en: We're on HBO or on Apple Plus.
And, like, frankly, it's kind of awe-inspiring.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这简直让人心生敬畏。

sentences.en: You know, it's pretty, like, wow.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，挺让人惊叹的。

sentences.en: And it inspires me to work harder.
sentences.zh: 这激发了我更努力工作的斗志。

sentences.en: I was hoping that something would finally inspire you, Sean.
sentences.zh: 我还希望有什么事能最终激励到你呢，肖恩。

sentences.en: One more day at this rate.
sentences.zh: 按这个速度再过一天就完了。

sentences.en: You wear an R2-D2 t-shirt and you just, the signals that you're sending is just, don't hire me is why all that.
sentences.zh: 你穿着一件R2-D2的T恤，你发出的信号就是，别雇我，这就是原因所在。

sentences.en: This says, help me, not help me, Obi-Wan.
sentences.zh: 这件衣服写的是“救救我”，不是“救救我，欧比旺”。

sentences.en: Help me any, just change my circumstances.
sentences.zh: 随便谁救救我，只要改变我的现状就行。

sentences.en: I'm doing a Miss Universe project, too.
sentences.zh: 我也在做一个环球小姐的项目。

sentences.en: There's a script I'm doing with your dad.
sentences.zh: 我有个剧本正在跟你爸爸合作。

sentences.en: Oh, we couldn't even get that one out.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们连那个都没能搞出来。

sentences.en: I was going to do it the last time that you did that to us.
sentences.zh: 上次你对我们做那种事的时候，我本打算去做的。

sentences.en: You dropped your dad leaving a few times mid-conversation, which is so rude.
sentences.zh: 你聊着聊着中途好几次把话题扯到你爸身上，太粗鲁了。

sentences.en: And the guest is always like, Jesus, Sean.
sentences.zh: 而且嘉宾总是会说，天哪，肖恩。

sentences.en: Okay, guys, thank you for being such great hosts with my guest today, Reese Witherspoon.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，谢谢你们今天和我的嘉宾瑞丝·威瑟斯彭相处得这么融洽。

sentences.en: Truly was the fastest hour, I have felt.
sentences.zh: 我真心觉得这是过得最快的一个小时。

sentences.en: Why are you leaving so quickly?
Something you got to do today?
Listen, Sean, let me just say a couple of things.
